name: Decision judges on the real-transcript validity set v1
judge_order_note: One fresh container (so one process) per judge, nothing else on its GPU. pplx sets process-wide torch options (8 CPU threads, cuDNN SDPA off), so judges must not share a process. On Modal the four run in parallel, each on its own container of the same spec.

hardware.gpu: H100! (1x NVIDIA H100 80GB HBM3; the ! stops Modal upgrading a call to an H200), driver 610.57.04
hardware.container: 8 CPUs, 128 GB RAM, image from env/requirements.txt installed with --no-deps, models on volume cb-judges-hf, results on volume cb-judges-results committed every 30 s
hardware.why: Clef (55 GB) and pplx-decider (52 GB) are bf16 27B models whose loaders place the whole model on one device, so every judge needs one GPU with >= 80 GB.

hardware_not_used.note: First planned on Vultr; Vultr refused the GH200 without a $50 cash deposit (credit doesn't count), so the run moved to Modal on 2026-10-15. vultr.py, deploy.sh, setup_host.sh, run_all.sh and pull_results.sh are kept for a self-hosted box.
hardware_not_used.gpu: 1x NVIDIA GH200 (96 GB HBM3), Grace Neoverse V2 72-core aarch64, 480 GB RAM
hardware_not_used.billing: hourly, preemptible only (Vultr lists no on-demand GH200); the runner resumes after a preemption
hardware_not_used.why: Clef (55 GB) and pplx-decider (52 GB) are bf16 27B models whose loaders place the whole model on one device, so every judge needs one GPU with >= 80 GB. As of 2026-10-15 this is the only such Vultr plan in stock.

software.kev_override: Kev declares torch<2.9; the env overrides it to 2.14.0. Kev passed the smoke test under the override, so env-kev (torch 2.8.0) was not used and all four judges ran in the same environment.

runner.truncation: none for any judge; an over-long unit is recorded as an error
runner.warmup: the first 3 calls of the plan, untimed and discarded, in every process
runner.models_predownloaded: all four snapshots are fetched by setup_host.sh before any timed run, so download time is never counted

metrics.validity: score_validity.py, pre-registered (#208, #323): human kappa, per-class recall with Wilson intervals, kappa vs reference, invalid rate, reweighted precision, judge-vs-human rates, by turn and input size
metrics.speed: speed_report.py: model load time, per-call latency (mean, p50, p90, p99, max) over timed successful calls, calls/s, input tokens/s where the judge reports tokens, peak GPU memory, mean GPU power and energy from nvidia-smi sampled every second, GPU time and cost at the hourly price
